chapter_title: Concerning the Eighteen Great Thrones of all the F

1.content: great thrones for all the fathers

11.original: [in the kingdom of the King of]
11.content: in the kingdom of the King of

spiritual_reading:
There is a full arrangement of governing degrees in the spiritual order: a sufficient complement of comprehensive principles is established in fixed determinations. Some are set in the outermost spiritual expanse where general states are held, yet their authority extends wherever devastation and disorder have spread, so that even ruined states are still under an appointing order.

The first governing degree is the inmost Divine itself as Divine truth and Divine good in supreme sovereignty, self-subsistent, unconditioned, and distinct from all derivative things; from it every other governing determination has its measure and subordination, and it stands above all.

The second governing degree is the Divine wisdom that is glorified by union with love; from it proceeds the whole outflowing of ordered spiritual forces that reach down into the lowest region where restoration must be effected.

The third governing degree is the primal Divine operation that first enters into conflict with the opposite; it is the initiating good that directly confronts and subdues the earliest universal resistance that rose from a state of active falsity.

The fourth governing degree is the Divine that is loved because it is pure illumination; it is the honored delight of wisdom in the heavenly expanse, by which truths are made lovable and goods are made bright.

The fifth governing degree is the Divine formative intelligence that constructs new spiritual states for renewal: it establishes an ordered heaven for the reception of good and truth, and at the same time establishes restraint, confinement, and fixed limitation for the opposing will and its derivative persuasions.

The sixth governing degree is the living Divine power that rescues the initiating good from immersion in falsity and evil; it also brings the lower degrees into order so that what is Divine may be separated from what is defiled, and so that hostile forces may be held in bonds and prevented from breaking forth.

The seventh governing degree is the mediating Divine agency that administers the intermediate region between higher and lower states, and disposes all deliberations and counsel so that influx may be adapted to recipients.

The eighth governing degree is the Divine truth made manifest in splendor for liberation; it is the active deliverer that looses what is bound in human interiors and restores souls to freedom of reception.

The ninth governing degree is the universal heavenly understanding into which all genuine communities of worship and doctrine are gathered as into one mind; to it returns every vitality that has been purified from mixed and contaminated states.

These are the nine governing determinations of honor set in the outer spiritual expanse, established for the enduring heavenly principles in the kingdom of Divine glory, in an unending state.

In contrast there is also a corresponding complement of nine governing determinations established within the intermediate realm where mixture and conflict occur.

Within the orderly alternations of enlightenment, three governing determinations are set: the mediating Divine agency for adaptation, the universal vivifying power that inspires and unites, and the rescuing living power that arranges and restrains.

Likewise within the alternations of obscurity, three governing determinations are set: the Divine truth made manifest for deliverance, the initiating good that first engaged the opposite, and the pure receptive principle that remains undefiled for the sake of new reception. These six determinations are fixed within the two alternating states so that governance persists in both brightness and shade.

Also, a seventh governing determination is fixed in the highest completed degree of the natural-spiritual order; upon it is present the supreme sovereignty of Divine glory, ruling the whole complex in ultimates.

An eighth governing determination is fixed in the intermediate common region that joins inner and outer states; upon it is the discriminating Divine truth that judges every human being. Before it three final determinations are made distinct: one that ends in the loss of spiritual life, one that opens into spiritual life, and one that remains in divided mixture.

These are the great governing determinations established within this intermediate world under the heavenly realm, set so that they may be acknowledged in their order, though the remainder of the description is unclear and resists full translation in its present broken form.

fills.fill: great thrones for all the fathers
fills.notes: Matches the substrate register: ‘thrones’ as fixed governing determinations; ‘fathers’ as enduring heavenly principles.

fills.fill: in the aeon of the Father
fills.notes: The first throne must be located in the inmost, unconditioned degree. ‘Aeon of the Father’ is the oldest-layer cosmological placement for the self-subsistent Father, without introducing later ecclesial framing.
Correspondentially required: self-subsistent, unconditioned being. Fits the sequence ‘he alone, in his own essence, … apart’.
Needed to close the identification: ‘This is the first throne …’ must restate whose throne it is, grounding the superordination ‘surpasses all the thrones’.
The Builder’s function is formative intelligence establishing a renewed heaven-state; ‘built the new aeon for a newness’ naturally completes with an apposition of the same governing structure.

fills.fill: so that he might set in order and construct the worlds
fills.notes: The Living Spirit’s correspondential work is ordering lower degrees and constructing the cosmos as a mechanism for separation and restraint; the gap must introduce that purposive clause before ‘both for a cleansing…’.

fills.fill: in the kingdom of the King of

fills.notes: Restores the fixed phrase naming these determinations; keeps the impersonal, structural register (not devotional).
The paragraph is summing the ‘other nine’ established in the intermediate realm; ‘world of the zone’ is the natural-layer expression for that mixed intermediate region.

fills.fill: king of honour and his powers
fills.notes: Correspondentially this clause must relate the zone-governance to the sovereignty that rules in ultimates (King of Honour) and to the operative forces by which it is administered (‘powers’).
Matches the spiritual translation: ‘set so that they may be acknowledged in their order’. This is the oldest-layer purpose statement (recognition of order).

fills.fill: remainder of the discourse is broken
fills.notes: The spiritual translation indicates the close is irrecoverable; this supplies a minimal oldest-layer notice of textual discontinuity without importing later editorial voice.

assessment: Most lacunae are short and tightly constrained by repeated formulae (‘thrones of honour’, ‘world of the zone’) and by the fixed ninefold order. The main uncertainties are in ¶2 (locative and resumptive phrases around the Father’s throne) and especially ¶18 where the surviving text only signals a concluding summary; those restorations are guided primarily by the correspondential structure (intermediate governance under the heavenly realm) rather than by recoverable surface syntax.
